blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all six V197 pose renders shows severe overskirt/lap collapse in crouch and sit: the front lap pulls away and large anterior thighs remain exposed, with the hem folding into the legs. The geometric pose diagnostic measures only 39.1–40.5% overskirt coverage and 23.5–24.6% front-lap coverage on the sampled upper thighs in crouch, and 31.6–31.9% overskirt / 21.2% front-lap coverage in sit. These are pose-sampling diagnostics, not fit or acceptance thresholds.

The standing front, back, three-quarter, neutral, and arms-up renders are much more coherent than V196, but the skirt still reads as a mostly smooth asymmetric apron with long streaked folds rather than a finished short pleated overskirt.
Direct left and right views show long, narrow hem sections projecting away from the skirt silhouette and looking detached; this remains a visible construction/deformation defect.
The five main views still show angular/faceted jacket torso patches and an uneven waist transition.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
